# Rimer stigende renter på danske aktier?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish EuroInvestor Millionærklubben episode, with host Bodil Gansel, technical analyst Lars Persson, Michel Nørgaard and ABG's Victor Fremming. It asks which stocks gain or suffer from higher interest rates. The panel sees long rates settling in a 'new normal' of roughly 2-6%, which is not catastrophic. High-multiple, highly indebted and rate-dependent companies such as Ørsted, Demant and Rockwool are more exposed. Banks such as AL Sydbank, insurers such as Tryg and low-debt names such as Carlsberg, Coloplast and Investor AB are seen as more resilient. Around this, they preview Novo's capital markets day (they are sceptical anything new will come out of it), discuss oil and Hormuz volatility, the Trump-Xi meeting, Swedish property and Swedish bank taxation risk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SYDB — AL Sydbank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Victor highlights it as the Danish bank with the most rate-sensitive loan book, so it benefits from higher rates.

#### Reasoning

Banks reprice loans faster than deposits, which widens net interest margin. AL Sydbank has the most rate-sensitive lending book in Denmark. Victor argues credit quality and regulation have improved since the financial crisis. Michel agrees but warns about impairments.

#### Sell Triggers

- if loan impairments rise
- if rates fall
- if credit quality deteriorates

> *"her kunne et navn som AL Sydbank, som er den bank i Danmark, der har den mest rentesensitive udlånsbog"*

---

### 🟢 TRYG — Tryg | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michel: higher rates lift the return on insurers' bond portfolios.

#### Reasoning

Insurers benefit directly from higher rates because the return on their bond holdings rises. Michel names Tryg as the example.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall back

> *"Det kunne fx være tryk. De har jo højere renter, og hvis du får højere renter, i det her niveau, så løfter det jo afkastet"*

---

### 🟠 COLO-B — Coloplast | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Low debt, defensive healthcare demand, reasonable pricing after a long sideways period.

#### Reasoning

Michel sees low gearing plus defensive demand as resilience to higher rates. The stock has been flat for a long time and pricing looks sensible.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth disappoints

> *"Koloplast, som jo har ligget et ret langt tid og søbet rundt"*

---

### 🟠 CARL-B — Carlsberg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Named as a low-debt company that is resilient to higher rates.

#### Reasoning

Michel cites low gearing as protection in a rising-rate environment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage rises

> *"Jamen det kunne for eksempel være Carlsberg"*

---

### 🟠 INVE-B — Investor AB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Low loan-to-value; more robust than other Swedish investment companies.

#### Reasoning

Michel suggests Investor AB because it has low leverage compared with more indebted Swedish holding companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage increases

> *"Fordi den har jo også den her lave belåningskraft"*

---

### 🟠 DEMANT — Demant | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Victor flags roughly 4x net debt/EBITDA with short-term financing; Michel counters with new products and demographic growth.

#### Reasoning

High leverage financed at the short end hurts at refinancing if rates keep rising. On the other side are new products (Oticon), an ageing population and a valuation that may already price in trouble. Big Tech entry is a long-term risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if refinancing costs spike
- if Big Tech enters hearing aids
- if it loses the product cycle

> *"Jeg vil fremhæve Demand. Demand har den højeste gearingmål"*

---

### ⛔ ORSTED — Ørsted | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A project developer whose earnings lie far in the future, so rising rates hurt it.

#### Reasoning

Victor: business models tied to interest rates, such as project development, suffer because long-dated cash flows are discounted harder.

> *"Her i Ørsted er jo i virkeligheden en projektudvikler"*

---

### ⛔ ROCK-B — Rockwool | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Construction demand is hurt by higher rates and oil costs; Michel says it is not the most obvious bet.

#### Reasoning

Higher rates hit construction financing, its main end market, and oil raises input costs. Offsets are EU infrastructure, US expansion and data-centre insulation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil falls, cutting input costs
- if the construction recovery surprises

> *"det er i hvert fald ikke det mest oplagte bet"*

---

### 🟡 SWED-A — Swedbank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars parks Swedish banks because of the proposed bank tax, though he regrets selling Swedbank, which is up 26%.

#### Reasoning

Strong performance and the money-laundering issue is resolved. The new government's proposed bank taxes create uncertainty, so Lars stays on the sidelines.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Swedish bank tax is enacted

> *"jeg skulle have beholdt min Swedbank"*

---

### ⛔ SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Weakest Swedish bank, up only 3%; bank tax risk.

#### Reasoning

Lars calls it the most boring Swedish bank, which has struggled to recover. Political tax risk adds to that.

> *"det er Handelsbanken, der kun er stedet 3%"*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

The capital markets day needs concrete pipeline, supply and margin targets; the panel fears disappointment.

#### Reasoning

Consensus sees negative growth; it has lost first place to Lilly; the semaglutide patent expires in the early 2030s. Oral Wegovy supply is key. The panel fears 'soft' messaging will disappoint investors.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the capital markets day lacks concrete targets
- if margin guidance is weak

> *"så hvis investorerne bliver skuffet, så går det jo den forkerte vej for Novo igen"*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Institutional investors stay neutral because of Hormuz freight-rate uncertainty.

#### Reasoning

Victor says Mærsk is a freight-rate proxy, and conflicting geopolitical news makes a neutral weighting the easiest stance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if freight rates collapse

> *"det måske er lettere, at man bare er neutral i det navn"*

---
